name: Cost estimates

subjectOf.text: Analyst estimates place the annual cost of Dodd-Frank Act registration and disclosure compliance for hedge fund advisers in a range from $50,000 to $400,000 per year.
subjectOf.abstract: Some analysts estimate that the cost will range from $50,000 to $400,000 per year (Kaal 2013a and 2013b).
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Barbara Luppi, Sandra Paterlini, Did the Dodd-Frank Act Impact Hedge Fund Performance (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2389416
scope_conditions: estimates by analysts, not measured by the authors

subjectOf.text: Estimates of annual Dodd-Frank Act compliance cost for private fund advisers range from $50,000 to $400,000 per year.
subjectOf.abstract: Some estimates suggest that compliance cost will range from $50,000 to $400,000 per year (Kaal 2013a and 2015b).
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Barbara Luppi, Sandra Paterlini, Did the Dodd-Frank Act Impact Private Fund Performance  – Evidence from 2010 – 2015 (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2816408

description: 2 claims in the published works of Wulf A. Kaal carry the concept tag 'cost-estimates'. Derived node: a roster, not an adjudicated definition.
